description: Answer the prompt a step is waiting on - do the model work in its `system` and `messages` first. Keep answering until the step is done or failed.

reply.description: Your answer: the JSON object the reply_schema asks for, written as JSON text - or plain text when there is no schema.

store.description: The store's link, as the person gave it: a public link (https://.../api/p/<id> or https://.../#/public/<id>, or its public id) or the person's private link (https://.../api/k/<id> or https://.../#/store/<id>). Leave it out to read the FactoGraph guide, a public store about FactoGraph itself.

name: replyToPrompt
title: Answer a step's prompt
